items.title: Greg Caputo interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 14, 1998
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Much like an athlete, just reach down and pulled out that, whatever Muhammad Ali had. [INTERVIEWEE] And he is, he’s up there with those people.

ctx.x: It was at Carnegie Hall. At the time the newspapers were on strike and they didn’t think there was going to be anyone there. It was sold out. And when they walked out there, just the sound of the hall and the sold out audience, everybody played phenomenal. Joe Morello had the flu, and how he ever pulled off this, what I only can say as far as I’m concerned, the greatest drum solo ever played, I would have liked to have been there for that.
Much like an athlete, just reach down and pulled out that, whatever Muhammad Ali had.
And he is, he’s up there with those people. It was a phenomenal concert. I would have liked to have been there. I think every musician would have a concert they’re after.
